3) We’ll loop in Sales Ops and Legal (CC’d: Marissa) to confirm change to billing terms if needed.

Would you be able to confirm items 1–3 by Monday so we can land an initial commercial path?

Jordan —

Great demo — thanks. Quick answers below to help you qualify:

- Vendor gating: yes — we need a completed vendor onboarding packet (W9 + vendor form) and a SOC 2 Type II report or link to the report. Those are required before we issue a vendor code.
- Payment lane: our standard is PO (Net 45) for SaaS > $10k/year. That said, Procurement will accept card for an initial pilot invoice if vendor cannot be onboarded within 30 days, but we need Finance sign-off.
- Marketplace: GCP Marketplace would materially simplify procurement for us (faster procurement and consolidated billing). It is not strictly required, but if Redwood is available on Marketplace it will accelerate approval and make ongoing billing easier — strong preference.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (ProcureCo_Vendor_Onboarding.docx). Michael (Finance) is CC’d — Michael, can you confirm whether ProcureCo AP will permit the initial-card + PO follow-up pattern for pilots? If not, what is the expected vendor setup SLA?

Laura O'Neill
Senior Procurement Manager, ProcureCo

Thanks Jordan — good capture. A few clarifications and next steps from Sales Ops / Legal perspective:

1) Pricing exception: we can approve a one-time card-for-pilot option (card payment for first invoice) for deals < $25k ARR. We'll flag this as an exception in HubSpot and require Finance approval.

2) PO onboarding: Sales Ops will prepare an MSA + the SOW stub you attached. Legal prefers we add a short clause that states: "Pilot invoice may be charged via corporate card; ongoing subscription invoicing will switch to Net 45 PO upon receipt of customer PO and vendor code." That should satisfy both sides and give ProcureCo the path to PO.

3) Marketplace: we have GCP Marketplace in our 2026 roadmap but not immediately available. Earliest we could list a pilot SKU is ~Q3 2026. I'll provide a Marketplace status note for the buyer so they understand timing — it helps but is not an immediate blocker.

4) Security artifacts: Marissa, can you share the SOC2 link and any short answers for the vendor form today? We'll include that in the vendor packet and aim to complete vendor onboarding within 10 business days once they return the form.

I'll create a HubSpot task (linked) and draft the MSA + pilot clause. Jordan — please upload ProcureCo_Vendor_Onboarding.docx and loop Finance if needed.
